title: bin_ambi_reduced_decode_fir2
description: `bin_ambi_reduced_decode_fir2` calculates a reduced set of HRIRs for higher-order Ambisonics binaural decoding by encoding real and optional phantom loudspeaker positions, computing a pseudoinverse decoder matrix, and combining its columns with left-ear HRIRs and a fadeout table. Use messages such as `calc_pinv` to start matrix encoding and `calc_reduced` with an Ambisonic-channel index to calculate the corresponding reduced HRIR; it supports up to 12th-order 2D or 5th-order 3D decoding.
